outcome_summary: Starved to death after an unresolved fire-room upgrade pickup
improvements: Before walking toward an unknown frost-potion test, the bot now checks whether it can protect its other potions. It declines an infeasible new approach while preserving recovery for an already-started stash.
incoming_learnings: Check potion-protection feasibility before walking toward an unknown frost test. An infeasible unstarted approach should not consume floor-wide preparation availability. Continue to require real stash, effect and collection evidence; selecting another action does not establish retrieval or survival.

review.review: The accepted final transition confirms starvation death, not a skeleton kill: decision 3632, log line 10666, explicitly reports hunger death after HP falls from 1 to 0. The initiating impasse began earlier. Floor-seven starvation appears at decision 2683, line 7634, before the first observed magical fire. At decision 2756, line 7847, the bot sees an upgrade scroll at 1005 and food at 974 beyond the fire buffer, with HP 53/55 but no carried food. Source browsing resolves the selecting chain: priority_resources.py:118–136 already delegates inaccessible pickups to puzzle preparation before mapping. However, puzzle_supplies.py:390–392 declines while starving, before frost staging or identification. The recorded frost-preflight change therefore is not the demonstrated blocker. Decision 2909, lines 8278–8281, retains the mandatory pickup veto and spends healing; decision 2910, line 8283, waits at full HP while still starving. From decision 2909 to death the clock advances from 2856 to 3550, including 444 last-resort waits. No pre-death observation identifies a carried frost potion; its later revelation cannot justify earlier use. No patch or new regression is supplied because no safe replacement preparation is established: removing the starvation gate would relax unknown-test admission, and waiving the upgrade obligation would violate intended progression. A known identification/extinguishing resource or a validated, budgeted preparation alternative is needed. No policy-memory reconstruction or counterfactual gameplay was performed. The unchanged full suite passed 1,565 tests with four skipped; this does not establish a recovery solution.
review.learnings: Distinguish inaccessible mandatory loot from completed loot. Healing to full health does not restore potion-test eligibility while starving. Check the actual preparation gate before blaming potion protection or extending fallback waits. Preserve public identification, hazard checks and mandatory progression; selecting preparation alone would not prove extinguishing or retrieval.

A safe correction needs a contemporaneously known identification/extinguishing resource or a recorded-input-validated preparation alternative satisfying hunger, health, hazard, bank/protection and retrieval budgets.
